tool_count.note: Tool set is fully user-configured (MCP/OpenAPI/LangChain); no default count given in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Seamlessly integrate tools via OpenAPI specs, MCP servers, and Langchain, enabling rapid connection to REST APIs, custom protocols, and Python functions
